decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:EH013-BLL-02-XX-DR-A-2004EH013-BLL-02-ZZ-DR-A-1001EH013-BLL-02-XX-DR-A-2002EH013-BLL-02-ZZ-DR-A-1002EH013-02-0001EH013-02-0002EH013-02-0003Arboricultural Impact Assessment, Prepared by MM Environmental Ltd Dated 5 May 2026Flood Risk Assessment (Ref: FRE/FRA/2026/28TL Rev 2)Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

No development above slab level shall take place until details of the proposed source control Sustainable Drainage Systems (SuDS) measures have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The submitted details shall demonstrate how surface water runoff from the development will be managed through source control SuDS measures, which may include permeable paving, rain gardens, green roofs, water butts or other equivalent features. The details shall include:a) a site layout plan showing the location and extent of all proposed SuDS features;b) specifications, dimensions and design calculations for the proposed SuDS measures;c) details of any attenuation storage and discharge arrangements;d) details of any infiltration proposals, including supporting site investigation and infiltration testing where appropriate;e) evidence of how runoff from the proposed development will be managed and controlled;f) a maintenance and management plan identifying responsibility for the ongoing maintenance of the drainage features throughout the lifetime of the development.The approved measures shall be fully implemented prior to first occupation of the development and shall thereafter be retained and maintained in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk, minimise discharge of surface water outside of the curtilage of the property and ensure that the drainage system remains functional.

Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved, the flood resilience, flood resistance and flood compensation measures identified in Sections 7.2, 7.3 and 7.5 of the approved Flood Risk Assessment (Ref: FRE/FRA/2026/28TL Rev 2) shall be implemented in full.Reason: To ensure the development remains safe for its lifetime, having regard to the identified residual surface water flood risk and to minimise the risk of flooding to occupants and property.
